articleTitle: Virtual Reconstruction and 3D Visualization of Vostok Spacecraft Equipment
publicationTitle: 2017 International Workshop on Engineering Technologies and Computer Science (EnT)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach of the investigations in the field of the History of Soviet manned space flights. 3D models of space equipment give the possibility to form a virtual internal and external appearance of the lost samples of the spacecraft. Main results based on 3D computer reconstruction, creation of 3D documents and 3D visualization technology.

Author Keywords: history of Soviet manned space flights

articleTitle: Electronics in Russia and Socio-Economic Reforms
publicationTitle: 2017 International Workshop on Engineering Technologies and Computer Science (EnT)
abstract: The data characterizing the development of electronic industry of USSR and Russia before and after the collapse of the Soviet Union. Information concerning the measures aimed at overcoming the systemic and technological crisis in electronic industry of Russia.

articleTitle: Some Critical Points in the History of the Soviet Computer Industry Development
publicationTitle: 2017 International Workshop on Engineering Technologies and Computer Science (EnT)
abstract: The article describes a number of critical moments in the creation of Soviet computer technology and the outstanding role of Academician Keldysh in solving these problems.

articleTitle: Computer Crimes, Computer Security and Computer Law: Phenomenon’s Dynamics Notes from the Russian Chair of Computer Law
publicationTitle: 2017 International Workshop on Engineering Technologies and Computer Science (EnT)
abstract: The article describes the practice of applying laws on computer crimes in the Russian Federation, as well as the situation with computer security and the training of specialists in the field of computer law.

articleTitle: Biotechnology and Computer Modeling on the Way to Treating Genetic Disorders
publicationTitle: 2017 International Workshop on Engineering Technologies and Computer Science (EnT)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the history and prospects of gene therapy, a new area of biotechnology that holds great promise for the treatment genetic disorders, cancer and dangerous infections such as HIV and hepatitis B. A brief history of gene therapy is described. The paper discusses the main lines of research in this area as well as the mechanisms, approaches, and techniques employed by gene therapy, and the examples of the experimental and clinical use of genetic constructs. Another important research area closely associated with gene therapy is the use of computer modeling and simulation. The paper also touches upon the ethical concerns surrounding this field of biomedicine, including its affordability and accessibility for patients.

articleTitle: Information Technologies of Training Cosmonauts for a Space Flight
publicationTitle: 2017 International Workshop on Engineering Technologies and Computer Science (EnT)
abstract: The paper shows historical aspects of the application of computer-based information systems, providing the process of cosmonaut training for a space flight at the Gagarin Cosmonaut Training Center. These systems include: systems ensuring the operation of simulation complexes for cosmonaut training, computer-assisted instruction systems (computer-assisted simulators), databases for storing the results of cosmonaut selection and training, information-management systems of cosmonaut training, cosmonaut training planning systems, data retrieval systems (electronic libraries, electronic catalogs), multimedia complexes, etc.

articleTitle: Creation of Galvanotechnics. A Historical Review
publicationTitle: 2017 International Workshop on Engineering Technologies and Computer Science (EnT)
abstract: The history of creating galvanotechnics in the 1800s-1920s has been traced on the basis of the threestage system of developing new productions (laboratory research - technological process - large-scale production) and on the model of creating a new production when research directions (or traditions) intersect. The contribution of each of these traditions into the establishment of galvanotechnics as an independent area (experiments with metal electric deposition, technologies of metal coating deposition by different methods, theoretical electrochemistry, chemical electricity sources, electrical engineering) has been considered.

articleTitle: From the Revolution to the Evolution: The Change in the Character of Development of Fiber Optic Communications Technology — And the Record Performance of 100 Gbit/s Systems as a Marker of this Change
publicationTitle: 2017 International Workshop on Engineering Technologies and Computer Science (EnT)
abstract: The performance of fiber optic communication systems reached its maximum several years ago with the introduction of 100 Gbit/s systems (100G). The further development of communication systems is going in such directions as complicating the formats of modulation, increasing the flexibility of tuning the occupied spectrum and increasing the speed of transmission over the carrier. This is advantageous for short lines, but leads to a significant reduction in transmission range and performance. Thus, the record performance of the 100G systems can be considered a marker for the transition from the revolutionary stage of the development of fiber-optic communication technologies to the evolutionary stage of their development.

articleTitle: Studies of the Wave Principles of the Conversion of Solar Radiation into Electricity as an Alternative to Space Solar Energy
publicationTitle: 2017 International Workshop on Engineering Technologies and Computer Science (EnT)
abstract: Traditional photovoltaics has, as you know, disadvantages: low efficiency of typical solar panels and their high cost. Therefore, back in the 1970s, a radical decision was made to use not the quantum but the wave properties of light to convert solar radiation into electric current. For this purpose, it was planned to arrange on the panel an array of nano-antennas connected to rectifying devices. These proposals could not be implemented until recently, when the first successful promising results were obtained. In parallel and independently, research and development began actively to develop in order to obtain electric energy in space orbit and to transmit it to Earth with a powerful ultra-high frequency beam. But approximately in 2008, the rapid development of traditional terrestrial photovoltaics began. In the prospects of the space direction, doubts arose. The article attempts to compare the terrestrial and cosmic variants of solar energy with historical and technical means.

articleTitle: S.I. Vavilov Institute for the History of Science and Technology of the Russian Academy of Sciences
publicationTitle: 2017 International Workshop on Engineering Technologies and Computer Science (EnT)
abstract: The 2017 International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Computer Science (EnT 2017) was held at the S.I. Vavilov Institute for the History of Science and Technology of the Russian Academy of Sciences (IHST) the leading Russian research institute for the history of Science and technology, on September 28, 2017. It was the fourth international conference EnT. The conference EnT 2017 was devoted primarily to the history of the development of computer and engineering technologies. A brief history is presented of the S.I. Vavilov Institute for the History of Science and Technology of the Russian Academy of Sciences.

articleTitle: Soviet Spacesuits as Objects of Computer Historical Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2017 International Workshop on Engineering Technologies and Computer Science (EnT)
abstract: The article represents retrospection of special suit (scaphandre, spacesuit) advancement. Chronology of Soviet aviation- and space- suits making, exploitation and technological features of various special suits are considered herein. Historical connections and continuity of technologies of their creation are given. The article contains the results of a new approach in the history of space technology. A space suit is considered as an object for 3D modeling. Virtual space suit became the basis for creating animation fragments that were used to reconstruct the most significant events of the history of manned space flights.

articleTitle: The Development of Aviation Museums and Collections in Russia
publicationTitle: 2017 International Workshop on Engineering Technologies and Computer Science (EnT)
abstract: Presented results of the work of collecting information about aircraft and aircraft engines in more than 30 Russian museums. They are presented in a traditional paper version as well as a database in Excel, allowing to analyze an array of 800 identified aviation artifacts on a number of parameters, and identify the most valuable exhibits. Based on the analysis of the collected material is made of aviation museums periodization, traced the positive and negative trends in their work in the post-Soviet period.

articleTitle: A New Look at the Content and Functions Virtual Museums of Electronic Engineering
publicationTitle: 2017 International Workshop on Engineering Technologies and Computer Science (EnT)
abstract: The creators of the existing virtual museums of electronic technology (VIME) are mostly single enthusiasts. They pay the main attention to the technical exposition. In separate VIME there are also unique materials - interviews with the leaders of enterprises-manufacturers of equipment for different years. The design of machinery and the preparation of production is a "kitchen" for the creation of technology that interests specialists. In this article, three examples of Russian developments in electronics based on interviews with company leaders show how success has been achieved. Revealed in this way, electronics together with interview texts can become exhibits of both VIME and traditional museums.

articleTitle: L. Maystrov and the History of Computer Technology Research in the USSR
publicationTitle: 2017 International Workshop on Engineering Technologies and Computer Science (EnT)
abstract: Leonid Efimovich Maistrov (1920-1982) is one of the first Russian historians of computing technology. He is the author of two classical publications, "The development of computing machines" (written in 1974 together with I. A. Apokin) and the catalog of computing machines stored in the museums, private collections, and institutions on the USSR (written in 1981 together with O.L. Petrenko). He authored a vast number of articles on different types of arithmometers. His other notable accomplishments include deciphering the marks on tally sticks, defining the role of the abacus in mathematics, and introducing the information about computing devices from the Russian museums for scientific use.

articleTitle: Eugen Sanger’s Hypersonic Bomber Project and Idea of it Realization in the USSR in 1946
publicationTitle: 2017 International Workshop on Engineering Technologies and Computer Science (EnT)
abstract: Presented documentary material about the project of Professor Eugen Sanger hypersonic strategic bomber and the search of the author of the project and his assistants to work on its implementation in the Soviet Union in the first post-war years.

articleTitle: Russian Fund of Algorithms and Programs: 50 Years of Experience: History and Actuality
publicationTitle: 2017 International Workshop on Engineering Technologies and Computer Science (EnT)
abstract: The article is devoted to the experience of the Russian and Soviet Fund of algorithms and programs. The fund, created more than half a century, played a noticeable role in creating a regulatory framework for requirements for replicable software. Fund experience also contributed to the development of the copyright to the software. Currently, due to the widespread use of free software, the fund performs also the function of a software product repository.

articleTitle: Entropy Function of Finite Words
publicationTitle: 2017 International Workshop on Engineering Technologies and Computer Science (EnT)
abstract: The aim of the article is application of entropy defined in combinatorics on words for finite words; entropy function will be applied for solving classification and clusterisation problems.

articleTitle: V. L. Lenin, G. M. Krzhizhanovsky and the Development of the GOELRO Plan
publicationTitle: 2017 International Workshop on Engineering Technologies and Computer Science (EnT)
abstract: This article describes the genesis of Lenin's interest to the electrification of the country. The formation and the organization of GOELRO Commission work is also considred.

articleTitle: From Torpedogleiter to Fledermaus. Siemens and the Development of Remotely Controlled Aircraft, 1915-1918
publicationTitle: 2017 International Workshop on Engineering Technologies and Computer Science (EnT)
abstract: The outbreak of war caused in Germany attempts to develop remotely guided vehicles. In 1915 electrical firm Siemens started to work with the wire-controlled bombs dropped from aircraft. In 1916 year inspection of the German Air Force, Siemens and Mannesmann Companies have decided to jointly develop the project "Fledermaus" with the desire to create a remotely controlled drones to bomb. By the end of the war after a series of experiments, the Germans began to prepare serial production of unmanned bombers.

articleTitle: The Informatics and Computer Technologies Heritage in Russia
publicationTitle: 2017 International Workshop on Engineering Technologies and Computer Science (EnT)
abstract: The article gives a brief overview of the main resources on the history of calculating devices and computing machines from the 19th century to the present day, which are preserved in Russian museums and archives. Many subjects and documentary materials still require further study and introduction into scientific circulation.
